name: Full Metal Schoolgirl: Deluxe Edition
summary:
The "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" Deluxe Edition is a deluxe package that includes the main game bundled with additional DLC coming after the game is released.

--Deluxe Edition Early Purchase Bonus Content--
-Additional Costume: Ryoko Costume: Aya's Battle Suit from "OneeChanbara ORIGIN"
-Additional Costume: Akemi Costume: Saki's Battle Suit from "OneeChanbara ORIGIN"
*Only for those who purchase from the PS Store by 3/31/2026 11:59pm.

--Deluxe Edition Contents--
1. "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" Main Game
2. "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" Season Pass
--Season Pass Contents--
1) Accessory: "Dopey Panda" in 2 Color Varieties
2) Accessory: "Victory Daruma" in 2 Color Varieties
3) Accessory: "Grey Alien" in 2 Color Varieties
4) Accessory: "Cat Tail" in 2 Color Varieties
5) Accessory: "Raccoon Tail" in 2 Color Varieties
6) Accessory: "Fox Tail" in 2 Color Varieties
7) Other 8 additional costumes
8) New Feature
